description: SafeStreets is a software platform listed in Urban and Regional Planning Resources (APA Technology Division), a curated directory of planning data, software and learning resources under the section "Platforms and Software Resources > Transportation Planning Tools and Platforms", published or maintained by as named on safestreets.streetsandcommons.com. A free, OpenStreetMap-based web platform providing address-level walkability and pedestrian-safety scores on a 15-minute-city framework (daily-needs reach, transit access, and walking comfort). The licence is not stated in the list entry (source page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. The entry links to a product or project page, not a repository, so open-source status was not confirmed and is recorded as false. It can support transport and planning studies.
